verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships an official MCP server (with OAuth flow and service-key auth) that lets AI assistants connect and act on a user's workspace, effectively enabling natural-language operation via an AI agent intermediary, and Fieldwork's AI agents also handle evidence collection tasks described in natural terms. However, evidence doesn't detail the specific range of commands/actions supported through MCP, nor any first-party chat/NL interface within Oneleet itself, and there's no independent hands-on verification of the MCP experience. Missing for 10: documented list of natural-language-operable actions via MCP, first-party in-app NL interface, independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP workflow.
